title: Primitive radix–Möbius dynamics: RC3.3 exact certificates and verification software
description: Exact certificates, checkers, claim/dependency records and reproducible figures supporting the forthcoming article Finite Rational Components in Primitive Radix–Möbius Dynamics: Content and a Sharp Threshold. Includes scoped fifth-coordinate and all-height bounded-cofactor certificates. Global five-state realization, uniqueness and least-base questions remain open. Manuscripts are excluded under the pre-arXiv embargo.
